notes.title: Mother's Ghost (description)
notes.notes:
[b]Hello dear friend! [/b]
Well, I decided to share information about an enemy who will haunt you until the very end of the game =)
How the attacks will take place in general, everything is elementary here, you can't stay in the dark, for this you will have to make sure that the gasoline is in the lighter or stay near the candles you lit (a kind of safe zone), but they also have time to run out. Gasoline reserves are actually not much and you will have to save.

[b]Ghost Model[/b]
This is really terrible shit, testing variations of its placement (I thought it could make it forever wandering around the house, but does not see you while you are in the light, but refused) knowing that it is there and having already bored me, goosebumps were constantly passing through my body. The model is of high quality, and all its textures and movements are performed at the level.

[b]Ghost AI[/b]
Unfortunately, I did not fully manage to set up her intelligence correctly, and I hired a good programmer, we are almost finishing now and now we can say that it will work like clockwork =)
